description: Land Acquisition - Kadaweediya, Matara Four Gravets D/S Division, Matara District and Samagipura, Medirigiriya D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition for public purposes under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, and extents in multiple locations. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilake), this is only in the context of his statutory role in land acquisition declarations, not about government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The core content focuses entirely on land matters, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
